note: The candidates for the roster of major US companies (Assets/Resources/Data/economy/companies.json): the 75 curated companies of company-lives.json ("curated": true; their fields come from there), and for each of the 23 market industries of industries.json the US companies that were among the largest in it at some time from 1947 to 2025, today's largest (CompaniesMarketCap's ranking of US companies, Nov 2026; the S&P 500's sectors) and the historical giants that still traded after 1996, when CompaniesMarketCap's year-end history begins (Fortune 500 era leaders delisted earlier have no measured value and are left out). "industry" is the authored industry (the BEA's establishment view: a food processor is manufacturing, a pipeline is transport); Jev's choice replaces it at confidence 0.6 or more. "wiki" names the English Wikipedia article whose opening Jev reads; "cmc" the CompaniesMarketCap page (a slug, false for none; absent: found by ticker in the US ranking). founded/ended/fate/successor/sells are authored (company histories), not measurements.
